analysis.insight_summary: A user has observed that values input on the display are visible there but do not update on the connected controller. The setup includes specific firmware versions, suggesting possible compatibility issues between the display and controller hardware, particularly since older hardware did not show this problem. No solutions have been proposed, and seeking official support is advised.
